expedition: Seascape Alaska 5: Gulf of Alaska Remotely Operated Vehicle Exploration and Mapping
purpose: To target one of a number of enigmatic small seamounts present in the Gulf of Alaska that are on the order of 10 km across and several hundred meters high that may be small volcanic vents or mud volcanoes.
